scope: No designs exist. Review of S1-S9 after the PI decisions of 2026-10-27 (dislocation definition, mu_req first, insertion rules accepted, expand/latch allowed). Python now runs for this role: all numbers below come from scripts in work/agents/safety/ (s03-s07), notes in r0003_notes.md. Round-2 analysis (work/board/r0002/safety.json) still stands where not repeated.
evidence_files: work/agents/safety/s03_geometry.py -> s03_geometry.json (footprint, gaps, opening chord, uncinate distance)
work/agents/safety/s06_frame_artifact.py -> s06_frame_artifact.json (apparent translation from vertebral rotation)
work/agents/safety/s07_bestfit_loophole.py -> s07_bestfit_loophole.json (best-fit rigid motion hides a moving hard core)
correction_of_own_earlier_claim: r0002 note N4 ('~0.35 mm midline overlap with a posterior lip blocks posterior motion') is WRONG for the FE model: inside the modelled disc space the gap rises monotonically from 2.96 mm (anterior lip, X +3.8) to 5.30 mm (posterior footprint edge) and 5.48 mm (posterior outline); posterior closure = 0.0 on Y = 0 and Y = +/-3 mm (s04_midline_profile.json). I had used the STL value 'posterior 4.1 mm' (DECISIONS_baseline_human_c34.md:15), which does not match the FE disc mesh. Conclusion is stronger, not weaker: there is no geometric stop toward the cord at all.

headline_findings.finding: The endplate wedge pushes any contour-matched cage toward the spinal cord under the clamp alone. Uniform clamp pressure on the real C3 / C4 surfaces gives a net posterior force of 0.165 x the normal force; friction needed for the clamp alone = 0.083 (whole footprint), 0.105 (anterior half, where an S2-compliant hard core will bear). This uses 41-52 % of the friction budget at mu 0.2 before any neck motion. Independent support: F-0011, follower load only, p062 corrected rerun, bottom face 11.02 / 105.15 = 0.105.
headline_findings.consequence: posterior safety rests entirely on friction (no shape stop, N2) with a large part of it already spent; the posterior mu_req check must include the clamp-only state (end of release, before moments) and keep margin.

headline_findings.finding: 'Translation relative to C3 and C4' measured during the load contains rotation of the vertebra, not cage motion. Cage centroid is 6.15 mm from the ICR; at the gate-2 flexion angle 5.78 deg a cage stuck to C4 shows 0.62 mm relative to C3 (0.86 mm at 8 deg), almost all antero-posterior. This alone breaks the 0.5 mm posterior limit with zero slip (false fail), and in the reverse sign can hide real slip (false pass).

The PI's dislocation measure (best-fit rigid motion of ALL cage nodes) can hide a hard part moving toward the cord: best fit = (node fraction of the moving part) x (its motion). A hard posterior part with 20 % of the nodes moving 1.5 mm reads 0.30 mm; 35 % moving 1.0 mm reads 0.35 mm; both pass 0.5 mm. Node-count weighting also changes with mesh density.

docs/PLAN.md is not updated to the PI decisions of 2026-10-27: S2 (PLAN.md:28) still says 'hard PLCL strain <= 3 %, compliant <= 40 %' although the PI accepted 'hard core no compression, soft <= 30 %, posterior checks at mu 0.2' (DECISIONS.md 2026-10-27 (3)); S9 (PLAN.md:35) still says 'cage-centre translation' and has no mu 0.2 for the posterior checks. The project's own material card gives hard elastic limit 15 / 649.53 = 2.31 % < 3 % (F-0019). Any code written from PLAN.md would implement the rejected rule.

Still no implementation of S1-S9 (no constraints*.py anywhere; find, 2026-10-28) and still no work/requests/ folder: none of the round-1 / round-2 change requests is tracked. The designer must not start before L0 checks exist.
headline_findings.evidence: find . -name 'constraints*.py' -> none; ls work/requests -> absent (2026-10-28); work/findings/F-0017.json (2)

constraints.rule_now: voxels only inside the 1 mm inset footprint and between the endplates (by construction)
constraints.harm_prevented: cage material against the dura / spinal cord (posterior), nerve roots in the foramen and vertebral artery (lateral, beyond the uncinate processes), oesophagus (anterior)
constraints.why: as-built only. Margins measured: posterior footprint edge to disc outline 1.00 mm (PLL resected); footprint edge to the first uncinate bone 0.51 mm laterally (|Y| 5.73 vs 6.24 mm) (s03_geometry.json). A soft posterior bulge under load is now explicitly outside S9 (PI 2026-10-27 (b)) but no rule with a number exists for it -> add S1b canal clearance.
constraints.recommended_value: S1 unchanged (inset 1.0 mm). ADD S1b canal / foramen clearance: in every loaded state of every test, no cage node may lie posterior of (posterior footprint edge - 0.5 mm) or lateral of (lateral footprint edge + 0.5 mm), measured in the disc-space frame (mean of C3 and C4 motion).
constraints.range: allowed excursion beyond the footprint 0.3-0.5 mm posterior, 0.5 mm lateral
constraints.plain_zh: 支架只能待在兩節頸椎之間的椎間盤空間裡，四周再往內縮 1 毫米。就像書必須放在書架格子裡、不能凸出來：後面是脊髓，兩側是神經根和椎動脈，前面是食道。新增一條：受力時軟材料也不能被擠到這條界線外超過 0.5 毫米。

constraints.rule_now: PLAN.md:28 (outdated): hard strain <= 3 %, compliant <= 40 %, transient gain <= 2 mm. PI-accepted 2026-10-27: hard core passes the narrowest anterior gap without compression, soft <= 30 %, transient 2 mm (1.5-2.5).
constraints.harm_prevented: implant that cannot be inserted without bone removal, is cracked or permanently deformed during insertion, or needs harmful over-distraction (facet / capsule overload, neck pain, subsidence)
constraints.why: accepted rule is correct but PLAN.md still holds the rejected numbers (H4). Measured: narrowest gap on the midline 2.96 mm at X +3.8 mm (an anterior lip, s04); anterior 120 deg opening chord 11.83 mm vs max footprint width 11.45 mm, so the width condition is met by any footprint-filling part (s03). Expand / latch designs (PI 2026-10-27 (2)) need extra checks (see missing item M14).
constraints.measurable: yes: L0 geometric path sweep + L1 static FE of the worst pose (r0002 recommendation)
constraints.recommended_value: as accepted by the PI 2026-10-27 (3) and written out in r0002 safety.json S2 (hard = local E(phi) > 20 MPa; every hard voxel inside the gap at T at every path step, 0.1 mm clearance; compliant column compression <= 30 %; path family straight and +/-15 / +/-30 deg; report insertion force). PLAN.md:28 must be rewritten to this text.
constraints.range: T 1.5-2.5 mm (surgeon to confirm); compliant compression 20-40 %
references: work/findings/F-0019.json (hard elastic limit 2.31 % on the model's own card)
Hsueh LL et al. 2023 Sci Rep, doi:10.1038/s41598-023-44998-4 (final over-distraction >= 2 mm harmful; not a transient limit)
constraints.plain_zh: 支架必須能從脖子前方一次整塊放進去，而且不能削骨頭。就像把床墊搬進一扇比較矮的門：硬骨架本身就要比門口（最窄約 2.96 毫米，加上手術時暫時撐開最多 2 毫米）矮，完全不壓；只有軟的部分可以被壓，最多壓三成。

constraints.harm_prevented: loose fragments migrating toward the cord or foramen
constraints.why: time-zero topology only; thin bridges and single-voxel soft flaps can tear during insertion (S2 compresses and slides soft parts on bone). Debris / delamination deferred by the PI (2026-10-27 (7)); a minimum bridge size is cheap at L0 and should stay.
constraints.recommended_value: one 6-connected component AND every bridge >= 0.8 x 0.4 mm; compliant regions bonded to the hard core over >= 2 voxels
references: Wuisman PIJM, Smit TH 2005, Eur Spine J 15:133-148, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3489405 (volume/pages unverified)
constraints.plain_zh: 支架必須是完整一塊，不能有分開的小碎塊。就像一串鑰匙都要掛在同一個環上；掉下來的碎片可能跑到脊髓旁邊。

constraints.rule_now: void connected to both endplates, >= 50 % of disc-space volume (PI 2026-10-26)
constraints.harm_prevented: loss of the purpose: no room and no nutrient path for the tissue-engineered biodisc
constraints.why: disc-space volume = 380.3 mm3 -> floor 190 mm3 void (s03). Volume alone can be met by a fine sponge with tiny endplate contact (F-0009 item 7).
constraints.recommended_value: >= 50 % void (PI) AND void contact area >= 30 % of the footprint on EACH endplate AND minimum channel width >= 1.0 mm
references: Urban JPG, Smith S, Fairbank JCT 2004 Spine 29:2700-2709 (endplate nutrition route; not re-read, unverified)
constraints.plain_zh: 支架裡至少一半空間要留給生物椎間盤，而且空洞要同時貼到上下兩塊骨頭。就像花盆要有足夠的土，也要有底孔讓水進來：養分從骨頭表面滲入，不能只是很細的海綿孔。

constraints.rule_now: min feature 0.4 mm X-Y, 0.2 mm layers, 45 deg overhang (PI kept 2026-10-26)
constraints.harm_prevented: designs that cannot be printed or print with defects
constraints.why: single 0.4 mm line in a load path is fragile; inter-layer strength 0.8 x bulk (DECISIONS_baseline_human_c34.md:116) with layers parallel to the slip plane
constraints.recommended_value: as PI decided PLUS load-path struts >= 0.8 mm (2 lines)
constraints.plain_zh: 設計必須能用 3D 列印機印出來：線寬 0.4 毫米、每層 0.2 毫米、懸空不超過 45 度。就像疊積木，上一層不能伸出太多。承重柱建議至少兩條線寬。

constraints.harm_prevented: cage collapse under maximal neck effort
constraints.why: 1164 N exceeds mean endplate failure 1084 N (Schroder 2006), so it must mean CAGE failure (bone is S8). Time-dependent strength deferred by the PI (2026-10-27 (7)).
constraints.measurable: yes, L2 compression with post-processed damage (DECISIONS_baseline_human_c34.md:93)
constraints.recommended_value: >= 1164 N before cage damage at the LOW strength set (hard 15, soft 3 MPa, inter-layer 0.8x); cite Moroney SP, Schultz AB, Miller JAA 1988 J Orthop Res 6:713-720
constraints.range: 800-1164 N (lower only with collar / restricted activity, PI decision)
references: Moroney SP, Schultz AB, Miller JAA 1988, J Orthop Res 6:713-720
Schroder J et al. 2006 Cent Eur Neurosurg 67:188, doi:10.1055/s-2006-942279
constraints.plain_zh: 支架要撐得住約 1164 牛頓（約 119 公斤重）的壓力而不壞，這是用力繃緊脖子時頸椎受到的最大壓力。就像椅子要撐住一個人重重坐下。

constraints.harm_prevented: loss of distraction -> narrower foramen (nerve root) and loss of clamp force (fixation)
constraints.why: 150 N has no cited source (unverified). Under S2 the tallest (posterior) columns must be mostly soft or void (gap there 5.30 + d vs hard core <= 2.96 + T), so S7 becomes binding and also sets the clamp that S9 relies on.
constraints.recommended_value: height loss <= d/2 at 150 N (keep); report clamp force after release for every design (needed for S9 push-out)
constraints.plain_zh: 在約 15 公斤重的壓力下，支架高度下降不能超過撐開量的一半。就像千斤頂撐住車子不能往下沉；高度一掉，神經出口變窄，支架也夾不緊。

constraints.rule_now: peak 1 mm2-averaged contact pressure below a subsidence proxy (no number)
constraints.harm_prevented: subsidence into the vertebral body; contact hot spots that crack the cage
constraints.why: still no number (PLAN.md:34) -> not testable; third round without a value
constraints.measurable: yes, L1 contact pressure; L2 yielded trabecular volume
constraints.recommended_value: peak 1 mm2-averaged pressure <= 5 MPa in all physiological states (100 N follower + 1.5 N m, 6 directions) and at 150 N; L2: yielded trabecular volume < 10 % within 3 mm of the endplate
references: Cheng CC et al. 2007 Spine, doi:10.1097/BRS.0b013e31811ece5a
Schroder J et al. 2006 (mean endplate failure pressure 10.5 MPa)
Morgan EF, Keaveny TM 2001 J Biomech 34:569-577
constraints.plain_zh: 支架壓在骨頭上的力量不能太集中，否則會像高跟鞋踩進草地一樣陷進骨頭。建議日常姿勢下任何一平方毫米上的壓力不超過 5 百萬帕（約每平方公分 50 公斤重）。

constraints.rule_now: PLAN.md:35 + PI 2026-10-27: dislocation = rigid-body (best-fit) radial outward motion of the whole cage relative to C3 and C4, <= 1 mm any direction, <= 0.5 mm posterior; posterior push-out >= 135 N; judged first by mu_req (whole-face limit, e02), frictional simulation checks the shortcut; mu 0.3 (0.2 / 0.45), posterior at mu 0.2
constraints.harm_prevented: migration into the canal (cord injury) or anteriorly (oesophagus, loss of support) - main goal
constraints.why: (1) No shape stop toward the cord in the FE disc space and the clamp alone already pushes posteriorly with mu 0.08-0.10 (H1). (2) 'Relative to C3 / C4' during load includes vertebral rotation: 0.62 mm false motion at 5.78 deg flexion (H2). (3) Whole-cage best fit hides a hard part moving toward the cord (H3). (4) mu_req has no pass mark for the posterior criterion; at mu 0.2 with zero margin any small error in e02 (F-0011: flat faces under-read up to 7.5x) or in the friction value goes straight to the cord. (5) 135 N push-out with friction only needs clamp >= 225 N (mu 0.3) / 338 N (mu 0.2) (r0002); v2 clamps were 18-115 N (DECISIONS_baseline_human_c34.md:584-585). (6) Friction re-anchoring makes soft contact layers creep ~0.74 mm spuriously over the protocol (F-0015) -> frictional check is not yet trustworthy for soft contact layers.
constraints.measurable: mu_req: yes once e02 handles curved faces (F-0011) and runs on the corrected physio data; frictional check: not yet (gates 2-4 not passed, F-0014)

recommended_value.posterior_mu_req: mu_req of every state with a posterior in-plane resultant, INCLUDING the clamp-only state after release, <= 0.15 (= 0.2 / 1.33 margin); computed with the full tangential traction on curved faces (F-0011 fix)
recommended_value.any_direction_mu_req: report; <= 0.3 / 1.33 = 0.23 recommended for ranking, no hard pass mark (PI)
recommended_value.dislocation_measure: report the maximum of (a) volume-weighted best-fit rigid translation of all cage voxels and (b) best-fit rigid translation of the hard voxels (E > 20 MPa); radial outward component; limits 1 mm any / 0.5 mm posterior
recommended_value.reference_frame: net (permanent) dislocation measured at the zero-load point after each cycle, relative to C3 AND to C4 (rotation artefact vanishes); in-cycle peaks measured in the disc-space mid-frame (mean of C3 and C4 rigid motions) with the same limits
recommended_value.ratcheting: net dislocation increment from cycle 2 to cycle 3 <= 1 um per cycle in every direction
recommended_value.push_out: 135 N posterior AND an anterior push-out along the reversed insertion path reported; both at mu 0.2

constraints.range: posterior mu_req limit 0.13-0.20; ratchet 0.5-5 um per cycle
references: Moroney SP, Schultz AB, Miller JAA 1988 J Orthop Res 6:713-720 (AP shear up to 135 N)
constraints.plain_zh: 最重要的一條：支架整體不能滑出來，尤其不能往後滑向脊髓（最多 0.5 毫米）。就像放在斜坡上的磚頭：這節椎間盤的空間前窄後寬，上下骨頭一夾，本身就會把支架往後擠，只剩摩擦力擋著，所以往後方向要用比較滑的情況來算，而且要留餘裕。另外量「有沒有滑」時，要扣掉頸椎本身轉動造成的假移動，也不能讓軟材料把硬骨架的移動平均掉。

missing_items.item: posterior wedge squeeze (clamp pushes the cage toward the cord) not in any rule
missing_items.why: H1: clamp alone needs mu 0.083-0.105; no geometric posterior stop exists in the FE disc space (H2 correction / s04)
missing_items.proposal: include the clamp-only state (after release, before moments) in mu_req and in the posterior check; designers may use the anterior lip and posterior soft bumpers, but posterior protection must be shown by calculation at mu 0.2

missing_items.item: expand-after-insertion / latch designs (allowed by the PI 2026-10-27 (2)) have no check list
missing_items.why: a mechanism that deploys inside the disc space can fail to deploy, deploy partly, deploy toward the canal, or un-latch under cyclic load; PLCL creeps at 37 C
missing_items.proposal: for every such design: (1) both the undeployed and the deployed state must pass S1, S1b, S3, S5; (2) the undeployed state alone must pass the posterior S9 check (failure to deploy must not endanger the cord); (3) deployment moves material only anteriorly, laterally inside the footprint or vertically, never posteriorly; (4) deployment force and instrument stated; (5) latch holds with hard-part stress <= 0.5 x low strength and does not open under the 6 directions x 3 cycles; (6) no part separates during deployment (S3 at every intermediate state)

missing_items.item: geometry source mismatch: STL posterior disc height 4.1 mm vs FE disc mesh 5.48 mm at the posterior outline
missing_items.why: whether a posterior bony lip exists decides whether any shape stop toward the cord is possible; the two sources disagree
missing_items.proposal: integrator: measure the bony gap from the C3 / C4 bone surfaces (not the disc mesh) along the midline to the posterior vertebral wall; report the difference

missing_items.item: facet over-distraction during insertion is not computed
missing_items.why: S2 transient 2 mm is a technique default; facet capsule load at that pose is unknown
missing_items.proposal: one FSU run: parallel distraction 2.0 mm, report facet capsule spring forces vs physiological flexion peaks

missing_items.item: M1 16-week degradation / creep, M10 insertion depth stop, M11 fatigue at posterior hot spots (Lintz 2021), M12 soft debris / delamination, M4 acid load, M5 sterilisation
missing_items.why: PI decision 2026-10-27 (7): applied once a prototype exists. Kept here so they are not lost; no action this round.
missing_items.proposal: re-open when the first archive elite exists

summary_zh:
安全守門員第 3 輪結論（還沒有任何設計，只審查規則；本輪終於可以自己執行程式，所有數字都有計算腳本，放在 work/agents/safety/）：
1. 最重要的新發現：在目前的頸椎模型裡，椎間盤空間是「前面窄、後面寬」（前方最窄約 2.96 毫米，往後一路變高到約 5.3 毫米），所以骨頭形狀本身完全沒有東西擋住支架往後（往脊髓方向）移動。我上一輪說「後方有約 0.35 毫米的骨頭邊緣可以卡住」是錯的，在此更正。
2. 更嚴重的是：上下骨頭夾住支架時，因為空間前窄後寬，夾力本身就會把支架往後擠，就像用兩根手指捏西瓜子，種子會被擠出去。算出來光是夾住、脖子還沒動，就需要摩擦係數約 0.08 到 0.10 來抵抗，等於在比較滑的情況（摩擦係數 0.2）下已經用掉四到五成的摩擦力。紅隊的發現 F-0011 用模擬算出 0.105，互相吻合。因此我建議：往後方向需要的摩擦係數必須不超過 0.15，並且要把「剛夾住、還沒動脖子」的狀態也算進去。
3. 量「支架有沒有滑動」的方法有兩個漏洞：(a) 頸椎彎曲時上面那節骨頭本身會轉動，支架明明沒滑，相對於上面那節骨頭看起來也會移動約 0.6 毫米，已超過往後 0.5 毫米的上限；應改在每次動作回到不受力時量，或用上下兩節骨頭的平均位置當基準。(b) 主持人訂的「整個支架的整體移動」是所有點的平均，如果硬骨架往脊髓方向移動 1.5 毫米、但軟材料留在原地，平均起來只顯示 0.3 毫米，會被誤判為安全；應另外單獨量硬骨架的移動，取兩者中較大的。
4. 建議新增一條規則（S1b）：受力時任何支架材料都不能超出原本範圍往後或往兩側超過 0.5 毫米，以保護脊髓和神經根。
5. 主持人允許「放進去後再撐開或卡住」的設計；我列出檢查清單，最重要的一條是：就算撐開機構失敗、沒有打開，支架也不能往脊髓方向滑。
6. 文件問題：計畫文件 PLAN.md 的插入規則仍寫著舊的「硬材料可壓 3%、軟材料 40%」，沒有改成主持人已核准的「硬骨架完全不壓、軟材料最多三成」；檢查規則的程式仍然不存在，修改請求也仍然沒有地方追蹤。設計者開始之前必須先補上。
